description: Tool-name probe for the managed-MCP experiment. A PreToolUse hook emits a systemMessage (renders as a visible hook block) with the EXACT tool name whenever report_issue is invoked, to compare the managed-server form (mcp__<server>__report_issue) against the plugin-bundled form. PURE POWERSHELL host command -- no python, no sh: Cowork Chat runs hooks on the Windows host, which has PowerShell but not python. systemMessage only (no additionalContext, which is injection-shaped and classifier-blockable). This plugin bundles NO MCP server -- error-reporting is supplied via bootstrap managedMcpServers.
